definitions.explanation: A recorded message left when someone doesn't answer the phone.
The device or service that records messages when calls go unanswered.

examples.japanese: {留守電|るすでん}に{伝言|でんごん}を{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: I left a message on the voicemail.

examples.japanese: {留守電|るすでん}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
{留守電|るすでん}が3{件|けん}{入|はい}っていたので、{急|いそ}いで{折|お}り{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I had three voicemails, so I hurried to call back.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}に{出|で}られないときは{留守電|るすでん}に{切|き}り{替|か}わる。
examples.english: When I can't answer the phone, it switches to voicemail.

examples.japanese: {留守電|るすでん}の{応答|おうとう}メッセージを{新|あたら}しく{録音|ろくおん}した。
examples.english: I recorded a new voicemail greeting.

notes:
{留守電|るすでん} is an abbreviation of {留守番|るすばん}{電話|でんわ} (answering machine/voicemail). It refers to both the voicemail system and the messages left on it.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {留守番|るすばん}: house-sitting, looking after the house
- {電話|でんわ}: telephone

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {留守電|るすでん}に{入|い}れる: to leave a voicemail
- {留守電|るすでん}に{残|のこ}す: to leave on voicemail
- {留守電|るすでん}を{聞|き}く: to listen to voicemail
- {留守電|るすでん}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check voicemail
- {留守電|るすでん}に{切|き}り{替|か}わる: to switch to voicemail

RELATED WORDS:
- {着信|ちゃくしん}: incoming call
- {不在着信|ふざいちゃくしん}: missed call
- {伝言|でんごん}: message
- {折|お}り{返|かえ}し: return call
